videos.title: Sailing: America's Cup
videos.description: The moment everyone was waiting for has arrived: the 36th America's Cup has started. Postponed a couple of days due to restrictions, it has finally started with a big start. The defender team started the day with an aggressive start and taking the lead, but Luna Rossa Prada Pirelli came to win this competition. What will happen at the end of this day? Watch the highlights of the competition. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: Facing Waves
videos.description: Facing Waves is an exciting and inspiring TV series that follows top paddlers as they discover the cultures, landscapes and adventures of the world's most amazing adventure travel destinations.Showing spectacular paddling by top athletes in the most stunning locations around the globe, Facing Waves goes from the Dominican Republic to a small town in Wales, facing different conditions in every location, immersing in an unforgettable experience. videos.title: Sail-Ho
videos.description: Welcome back sailors! Today we are indulging in the most fragrant gardens of the islands of Cres and Losinj where the beauty of nature is next level. These islands are also known as the favourite place for many boaters who like to enjoy beautiful beaches and top restaurants. Let's dive in! (Senderinfo).

videos.title: Sail-Ho
videos.description: In this episode we are in the Opatija Riviera – the jewel box of the Northern Adriatic. With its enchanting architecture and romantic seaside promenades, it instantly takes us back to glorious summer days of the historical elite and royals. Now, let us take you here in Sail-Ho Croatia! (Senderinfo).

videos.title: Inside Superyachts
videos.description: In the latest episode of Inside Superyachts we interview Ken Freivokh, designer of some of the world's most iconic yachts and concepts ever. Besides talking to the genius behind some of the best yacht masterpieces we meet with Thirty C leading CGI concept designers.Lastly, we know that no yacht would be complete without a vessel to get you to and from shore. Pascoe Tenders open their doors to us to have a look inside these space-aged, hyperluxurious tenders. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: America's Cup Insight
videos.description: When the out-spending was impossible, out-thinking did the job. Emirates Team New Zealand has dominated the 35th America's Cup Match seven to one to become the new Defender. After nearly two decades, the end of both the Alinghi and Oracle Eras is here and the kiwis are back on the top of the world. We will watch the battles, highlights and comments of this historic victory. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: Heineken Regatta
videos.description: Get ready to rumble in Simpson Bay where the St. Maarten Heineken Regatta will celebrate its 35th anniversary edition! With the official slogan being Serious Fun, it is no wonder people come from over 25 countries to attend this one of a kind regatta. Given this year's lineup, we are expecting some of the best sailing in St. Maarten. Watch the highlights of the 2015 edition! (Senderinfo).

videos.title: Tiree Wave Classic
videos.description: For 30 years, a small sleepy island found off the North West Coast of Scotland has played host to one of the most prestigious events known amongst the windsurfing community. 61 competitors have arrived on the island for the Tiree Wave Classic. This is about to become the stage for top level windsurfing techniques in one of the most challenging conditions the UK has to offer. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: Tahitian Swell
videos.description: The French Polynesia is world famous not only for its clear blue waters, but also for the quality of its waves to the delight of worldwide surfers. These waves are generated by the swell; an undulating movement of the sea surface that advances as it does not break.If the French Polynesia is one of the kingdoms of surfing, it is thanks to its geographical location. Nestled in the heart of the South Pacific, this group of five archipelagos cover an area as vast as Europe and benefit all year round from swells generated by the four winds.The conditions are therefore ideal for the many wave lovers

videos.title: Kite Masters
videos.description: In this episode, we focus on the French team. They dominated the KiteFoil World Series scene, with many great performances. We'll zoom in on Axel Mazella who clinched the Kitefoil European title and his second Kitefoil World title last season. Finally, we meet four-time World Champion, Daniela Moroz, who'll share some tips for how to gybe in the best possible way. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: Kite Masters
videos.description: We are finally back to action! After months of waiting due to the Covid-19 pandemic, athletes and sports enthusiasts had the chance to return to some high-end performances and demanding racing; for the 2020 Formula Kite Mixed Team Relay European Championships that took place in Ebensee – Lake Traunsee, Austria. Relieve the best moments on Kite Masters. (Senderinfo).

videos.description: Of Croatia's 3,600 miles of glimmering coastline, the most famous stretch is its southernmost region: the Dalmatian Coast, where dramatic limestones cliffs rise from the deep and islands are scattered just offshore.​ In Wind Masters, our team is set to explore the most popular sailing routes and the most beautiful places in the Croatian part of the Adriatic Sea. videos.title: Tidal
videos.description: Tidal follows the journey of Lisa Beasley. After she suffered a horrible BASE jumping accident, she struggles to return to the ocean, but ends convincing herself to venture back into the water. Lisa's journey begins with a childhood love of water and sea life. Lucky of surviving the accident, she must now face an immense recovery period that brings her closer to her mother as well as her first love: the sea.As Lisa struggles to find an exercise she can handle, she starts discovering the beauty surrounding Cape Town's ocean. The tidal pools in particular became very meaningful to Lisa's recover

videos.title: UIM F1 H2O World Powerboat Championship
videos.description: After over 85 championships in over 12 countries, the P1 world is fast, and growing. The international motorboat racing competition organised by the Union Internationale Motornautique (UIM) is the highest class of inshore powerboat racing, proving to be an adrenaline rush for both participants and spectators.The UIM F1H2O World Championship is the flagship series of international single-seater inshore circuit Formula powerboat racing. It attracts up to 20 of the world's leading drivers from 13 countries who navigate the lightweight, tunnel-hull catamarans reaching speeds in excess of 240km/h o

videos.title: H2O Racing: Aquabike
videos.description: Welcome to the 25th season of the UIM ABP Aquabike World Championship. The world's best jetski racers are once again looking for the UIM ABP World title in six categories: the Ski Division GP1, the Ski Ladies GP1, the Freestyle, the Runabout GP1 as well as the Ski GP Junior 3.3 and 3.2.They will prove their skills across different Grand Prixes around the world. The rider who gets the most points throughout the season will be crowned world champion.Get to know what to expect from this year's edition in this season preview. (Senderinfo).

videos.description: "We're just two surfers that decided we could no longer ignore plastic pollution in our oceans." -Luise Grossmann.Two young innovators created the first sustainable surfboard fin based on ocean-recycled plastics. videos.title: Cannes Yachting Festival
videos.description: The glamorous city of Cannes hosts the luxury Yachting Festival par excellence for the 40th time this year and a new Luxury Gallery has been opened in the Palais de Festivals to celebrate this landmark anniversary. Breathe in the boat show's opulence and learn about the latest trends in the yachting world! (Senderinfo).

videos.title: Salon Nautique Paris
videos.description: The Paris Boat Show is considered by the nautical industry one of the most important venues in the field. For the passionate French public, this event is an absolute must, and we agree there is no other place like the Paris Nautic as France is possibly the greatest boating nation on the world. Thousands are expected to arrive on the 3rd of December until the following weekend, and fans will be storming the pavillions of Porte de Versailles for the latest innovation and best deals. Are you going to miss it? Come join us, on Nautical Channel! (Senderinfo).

videos.title: Sailing to the Games
videos.description: Follow sailors from around the world as they prepare to compete on the world's greatest sporting stage and make history at the 2024 Olympic Games in Paris. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: What the Sea Gives me
videos.description: What The Sea Gives Me is a feature length documentary comprised of intimate & candid interviews with some of the ocean's most extraordinary ambassadors including Great White shark researcher Brett McBride, artist Matt Beard, photographer Chris Burkard, bodysurfer Angie Oschmann, conservationist Jean-Michelle Cousteau, free-diver Herbert Nitsch. We give you an honest and personal look through the eyes of those who thrive under the most extreme water conditions, those ensuring the proper care of the oceans for future generations and those who simply derive a sense of pure joy from the sea. videos.title: Nautical Adventure in a Landlock Country
videos.description: Switzerland: home to the Alps and important water competitions like the Bol d'Or Mirabaud, the most important inland lake regatta in the world. Today it becomes the chosen scenario for this Nautical Adventure in a Landlocked Country. From extreme wakeboarding to canoe polo, we will discover that, despite being located far from the sea, Switzerland has a vibrant nautical scene.Get ready to accompany Nautical Channel's host, Lucia Metzbauer, as she goes wakeboarding with local Swiss pros, learns about the annual Match Race regatta, tries her hand at Stand-Up-Paddle, and discovers the little know

videos.title: Ocean Safari: Kenya
videos.description: In this episode, Andi arrives to the ancient Arabic town of Lamu. She is about to discover what dhow culture means to the people of Kenya. She spends three days with the incredible Ali Lamu, dhow builder and carpenter who is trying to save the lost art of dhow building. A unique experience will reveal many secrets of the location and this traditional work that is getting lost amongst younger people. (Senderinfo).

videos.title: Sail-Ho
videos.description: In this last episode of the season, we visit Zagreb, the capital of the country and one of the most popular destinations in Croatia.
